title: Douyin Laoke Hotel Transactions Take a 12% Service Fee, Official Response States It Is Not Related to Advertising Bidding

content_html:
On August 11, according to the news, after Doubao is integrated with the hotel transaction channel of Douyin Laoke, it will implement an independent software service fee policy for successful orders. When merchants jump to Douyin Laoke through the Doubao entry to complete hotel orders, they will be charged a software service fee of 11.4% and a payment processing fee of 0.6%, resulting in a total rate of approximately 12%.

Regarding the market statement that "Doubao recommends hotels and takes a 12% commission," Liu Xing, the public relations director of Doubao, responded on Weibo on the evening of August 10, stating that this description is not accurate. Currently, Doubao's lifestyle service business does not have a paid promotion mechanism. Hotel recommendations do not charge advertising fees, and merchants cannot influence recommendation results or rankings through payments. The related fees are only generated after the order is completed and are mainly used for channel services.

Liu Xing said that unlike some platforms using a "commission + advertising" business model, Doubao currently mainly charges based on the outcome of the transaction. Merchants should pay more attention to the actual channel costs and the effectiveness of new orders. At the same time, Doubao's lifestyle services are still in the early exploration stage and will continue to optimize based on feedback from users and merchants.

Previously, on July 27, the Douyin Life Services Learning Center released the "Explanation of Software Service Fee Policy for Specific Channels on the Douyin Life Services Platform in 2026." According to the policy, starting from 0:00 on August 10, 2026, the platform will implement new software service fee rules for specific channel orders, with specific rates notified through the merchant's Douyin Laoke backend.

This policy indicates that the basis for calculating the software service fee is the amount paid by the user and the subsidy amount provided by other entities besides the merchant (such as platform general coupons). The rate is determined based on factors such as the type of merchant, product category, POI category, product type, and transaction channel. Among them, Doubao is included in the range of specific channels, and the specific rate may be adjusted according to the platform's service situation. Whether an order belongs to a specific channel is determined by the settlement statement.

content_html_zh:
8月11日，有消息称，豆宝与抖音老客酒店交易渠道整合后，将对成功订单实行独立的软件服务费政策。 商户通过豆宝入口跳转到抖音老客完成酒店订单时，将被收取11.4%的软件服务费和0.6%的支付处理费，总费率约为12%。

对于市场上“豆宝推荐酒店并收取12%佣金”的说法，豆宝公关总监刘星8月10日晚在微博回应称，这一描述并不准确。 目前，豆宝的生活服务业务尚无付费推广机制。 酒店推荐不收取广告费，商家无法通过付费影响推荐结果或排名。 相关费用仅在订单完成后产生，主要用于渠道服务。

刘星表示，与一些平台采用“佣金+广告”的商业模式不同，豆宝目前主要根据交易结果收费。 商家应该更加关注实际的渠道成本和新订单的效果。 同时，豆宝的生活方式服务仍处于早期探索阶段，将根据用户和商家的反馈不断优化。

此前，7月27日，抖音生活服务学习中心发布了《2026年抖音生活服务平台特定频道软件服务收费政策说明》。 根据政策，自2026年8月10日零时起，平台将对特定渠道订单实施新的软件服务费规则，具体费率通过商户抖音老客后台通知。

该政策表明，计算软件服务费的依据是用户支付的金额以及除商户之外的其他主体提供的补贴金额（例如平台通用优惠券）。 费率根据商户类型、产品类别、POI类别、产品类型、交易渠道等因素确定。 其中，豆宝纳入特定渠道范围，具体费率可能根据平台服务情况进行调整。 订单是否属于特定渠道由结算报表决定。
